label: first copy step (input = first original token) in long (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely on the step right after the first output, when the fed-back input is orig(0) and the model must output orig(1) (recall_idx 1 holds 89% of activation mass). It depends strongly on length: L=9 (t=10) carries ~77% of mass, L=8 about 12%, and it is essentially silent for L<=7. Even at L=9 recall_idx 1 only about half of sequences fire; which ones fire is modulated weakly by token identity (higher for orig(0) in {3,b} and orig(1) in {h,m,b,1,3}, more digits in the sequence), but no simple token rule separates them. Weak secondary firing at recall_idx 2 (8% of mass) and near the end of long sequences (recall_idx 7-8, ~3%). Never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Largest activations are at t=10 for L=9 with orig(0) = b, 3, or d.
